locked_source.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: five tiny LOCKED purchase-preview sprites for existing OpenTTD specialist rail models.
Edit target/reference is the provided five-model purchase guide. It shows existing available pixel silhouettes in this exact order: Standard TBM yellow cutter/blue cab; Deep TBM red collar/gray body; brown Earth hopper; blue-gray Rock hopper; orange/dark-gray spoil-hauler locomotive.
Create exactly ONE row FIVE columns, five complete separate icons. Reuse each reference model's same side-view silhouette, nose direction, proportions and simple pixel details. Render each in muted GRAYSCALE to communicate unavailable/technology locked. Add one small clear amber/gold PADLOCK at the lower-right of EACH icon, inside its 20x20 native footprint. Preserve recognizable distinctions between both cutters, both open hoppers and the box-shaped hauler. No extra vehicle, no new geometry, no letters/numbers, no signs, no model labels, no axes or grids.
Crisp deliberately low-resolution original Tycoon pixel artwork, not smooth shaded enlarged illustrations: each icon is designed to reduce cleanly to20x20 pixels. Padlock about5x6 native pixels, model centered above/left of it. Fixed top-left lighting. Exact same five-model order, five equal cells and broad alpha gutters. Transparent alpha background with no floor, tracks, white squares, text or shadows outside icons.
This is only locked UI presentation; it adds no gameplay definition or gate. Reference labels are guidance and MUST NOT appear in the output.

references.role: retained five-model available silhouette edit/reference target

locked_source.selection: Selected five separate genuine grayscale model previews with small amber padlocks, UI-only. User question clarified these are unavailable purchase previews, never world vehicle sprites. Original available images stay immutable.
